# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.

# rebin of result plot
In the main analysis CorrelationAnalysis.cpp we bin the main correlation histograms in 20 deltaphi bins and 20 deltaeta bins. Reduce the number of bins for the result plots by half so that we have 10 bins in both. The way our observable is reflected this corresponds with 5 bins with unique content. Ensure the 1D projections done in makeProjections.C project still the same regions of the histograms. For example teh hProjY should use select bins 0,5 instead of 0,10. Propagate the modification to the ProjX histogram and the jackknife calculations.

To implement these changes introduce a flag or variable to be passed through scripts for 1) number of deltaphi bins and 2) number of deltaeta bins.

Remake the data and MC productions for all pp, combined pPb, and MC curves shown in the result plots, and include a differentiating string in the produced file names so they dont override the 20 bin working point. Implement ONLY for the last results step, all other plots in the analysis/note do NOT need updated bin parameters. Run over the full result datasets for the inclusive and scan kinematic selections.

Produce the combined central value plots with the same unqiue production tag used for the production so the new plots dont override the current ones. Do not copy the plots to the overleaf for now, return with the path to the plots.

The inclusive kinematic selection is
 - Z pT 0-500 GeV, trk pT 0.5-15 GeV
And the scan kienmatic selections are
 - Z pT 0-30 GeV, trk pT 0.5-2 2-4 4-15 GeV
 - Z pT 30-500 GeV, trk pT 0.5-2 2-4 4-15 GeV

In addition to making the reduced bin choice plots for these standard selections make plots for these choices for fun
 - Z pT 5-350 GeV, trk pT 0.5-15 GeV
 - Z pT 5-30 GeV, trk pT 0.5-2 2-4 4-15 GeV
 - Z pT 30-350 GeV, trk pT 0.5-2 2-4 4-15 GeV
 - Z pT 20-40 GeV, trk pT 0.5-15 GeV
Make a beamer presentation with all these plots, with the official kinematic ones too. Make the plots BIG, three plots max per slide. Minimal text, just put the kinematic selections used in the slide titles.

Do not update the copilot instructions for this task as this is an exploratory study.

# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws.
